dashboard.title: Practice overview
dashboard.sourceLocal: Totals are based on the records saved on this tablet.
dashboard.sourceAccount: Totals are based on the records saved to your account.
dashboard.week.title: This week
dashboard.week.description: Records from %1$s to %2$s. Changes are compared with last week up to the same day and time.
dashboard.next.title: Lists to practice next
dashboard.next.description: Shows up to 3 lists you have not practiced yet, have not practiced for %1$d days or more, or with recent accuracy below %2$d%%.
dashboard.next.allPractised: You have practiced every list recently.
dashboard.trends.title: Trends by list
dashboard.trends.description: Seconds per word (lower is faster) and accuracy for up to the last 20 runs. Time is divided by the number of words, so runs before and after editing a list can be compared.
dashboard.trends.needTwo: The trend appears once there are at least two records.
dashboard.trends.noChart: Shown once at least two records include this value.
home.welcomeTitle: Typing practice with your own words.
home.welcomeDescription: Start practicing with a sample, or create a list of the words you want to learn.
devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Register the tablets and keyboards you practise on. Choose one in “Practice” and your records will show which device you used.
devices.defaultDetail: Ready to use without registering. It can’t be renamed or deleted.
devices.deleteRemoval: “%s” will be removed from the list.

devices.deleteRecords.one: The %d record practised on this device will not be deleted and will keep the device name used at the time.
devices.deleteRecords.other: The %d records practised on this device will not be deleted and will keep the device name used at the time.

devices.deleteNoRecords: There are no records practised on this device.
devices.empty.title: No devices registered yet
devices.empty.description: Choose a registered device in “Practice” and your records will show which device you used, so you can compare records by device.
devices.empty.example: e.g. Pixel Tablet + HHKB (US), Galaxy Tab + JIS keyboard
devices.current.heading: Device this tablet uses for practice
devices.current.changeLabel: Change the device this tablet uses for practice (current: %s)
devices.current.noteSelected: When you practise in “Practice”, this device is saved with your records. Each storage location remembers its own choice.
devices.current.noteUnselected: While nothing is selected, no device is saved with your records. Each storage location remembers its own choice.
devices.readOnly: While saving through the API, devices can be chosen but not added, changed or deleted. Edit them in the web app.
devices.dialog.addDescription: Register a device you practise on.
devices.dialog.editDescription: Change the displayed name and the layout / notes.
devices.dialog.name: Device name
devices.dialog.nameHelp: Shown in the device menu on the practice screen and in your records.
devices.dialog.layoutHelp: Noting the layout or settings helps when you compare records.
devices.dialog.use: Use this device for practice on this tablet
devices.dialog.useHelp: This device is saved with the records of your practice in “Practice”.
nav.theme.label: Dark mode
practice.empty: There are no words yet. Create a word list to get started.
practice.stats.label: Current run
practice.progress.label: Word progress
practice.feedback.mismatch: Doesn’t match from character %d. Press Backspace to fix it.
practice.feedback.composing: Text you are still composing is checked once you confirm it
practice.word.resume: Tap or press any key to resume

practice.aside.bestOrderAtCount.one: Highest accuracy first, then fastest · runs at the current %d word
practice.aside.bestOrderAtCount.other: Highest accuracy first, then fastest · runs at the current %d words

practice.picker.title: Choose a word list
practice.picker.description: If you choose another list in the middle of a run, you’ll be asked to confirm before it stops.
practice.switch.title: Stop practicing?
practice.switch.description: Your progress on “%1$s” (%2$d / %3$d words) won’t be recorded. You’ll switch to “%4$s”.
practice.device.heading: Practice device (can be changed only before a run starts)
practice.device.label: Device: %s
practice.result.title: Well done!

practice.result.firstAtCount.one: First record at the current %d word
practice.result.firstAtCount.other: First record at the current %d words

practice.result.saveFailed: Could not save the record. The result stays on this screen. Check your connection and try again.
practice.result.saved: Saved. This run ranks #%d on this list.
practice.best.empty: No records yet. Type a list to the end and the top 5 will appear here.
rankings.title: Best records
rankings.intro: Your personal best for each word list. Choose a list to see its top records and how your time has changed.
rankings.orderNotes.accuracy: Highest accuracy first; ties go to the faster run
rankings.orderNotes.speed: Fastest first; ties go to the higher accuracy

rankings.fallback.one: There are no records at the current %d word, so all records are compared.
rankings.fallback.other: There are no records at the current %d words, so all records are compared.

rankings.list.noDeviceRecords: Lists without records on this device (%d)
rankings.list.sorts.name: Name
rankings.detail.notPractised.title: Not practiced yet
rankings.detail.notPractised.description: Type this list to the end, and its personal best and top records will appear here.
rankings.detail.trend.title: Time trend
rankings.detail.trend.needTwo: Practice at least twice to see the trend.
rankings.detail.top.title: Top records
records.title: Practice history
records.intro: Your practice runs, newest first. See each list’s top records in Best records and your progress on Home.
records.day.heading: %1$s · %2$s
records.note: Word counts and device names are as they were at the time of practice.
records.delete.title: Delete this practice record?
records.delete.description: One record of “%s” will be deleted.
records.empty.title: No practice records yet
records.empty.description: Type a list to the end in “Practice”, and the time, accuracy, mistakes and device you used will be kept here.
records.filteredEmpty.title: No records match the filters
records.filteredEmpty.description: Change the list or device filter.
settings.title: General
settings.description: Settings for how Typle is displayed and where it saves.
settings.language.heading: Display language
settings.language.description: Choose the language used on screen. Your word lists and practice records stay as they are.
settings.language.note: The language you choose is saved on this tablet.
settings.storage.accountDetail: Saved to the same account as the web app
settings.storageHint: Data on this tablet and in your account are separate. Switching does not copy anything.
settings.accountHint: Signs in to the web app of Typle with GitHub, and reads and writes the same word lists, records and devices. The sign-in is encrypted with the Android Keystore and kept only on this tablet.
settings.signOut: Sign out and go back to this tablet
wordLists.page.title: Word lists
wordLists.page.description: Create and edit the word lists you practice with. Export a list as CSV to import it on another device or account.
wordLists.page.notFound: The word list you tried to open could not be found. It may have been deleted.
wordLists.manager.heading: Saved lists
wordLists.manager.search: Search by list name or word
wordLists.manager.noMatch: No lists match “%s”. Searches list names and words.
wordLists.manager.csvNote: CSV export saves the words, what to type, and notes (practice history is not included). Use it with “Import CSV/TSV” on the create and edit screens.
wordLists.delete.title: Delete “%s”?
wordLists.delete.withRecords: This deletes the word list and all of its practice history.
wordLists.order.label: Sort
wordLists.order.name: Name
wordLists.empty.title: No word lists yet
wordLists.empty.description: Add the words you want to practice and the text to type as the answer. You can also import them from a CSV or TSV file.
wordLists.editor.description: Add the words shown while typing and the text to type as the answer.
wordLists.editor.displayRequired: Enter the word to show, or delete this row (empty rows can’t be saved).
wordLists.editor.inputBlank: The text to type is only spaces. Leave it empty to use the word shown.
wordLists.editor.name: Word list name
wordLists.editor.nameHelp: Shown on the practice screen and in the word lists.
wordLists.editor.shortcutNext: Next field (adds a row after the last word)
wordLists.editor.recount: The word count changes from %1$d to %2$d. The %3$d records practised at %1$d words are kept but no longer count toward the best records.
wordLists.editor.discardDescription: If you leave now, what you entered will be lost.
wordLists.import.appendHint: You can add %2$d words after the %1$d already entered.
